stories.title: Hayat 78 sets up comfortable Hong Kong win
stories.subTitle: ICC WCL Championship
stories.seoTitle: Babar Hayat 78 sets up comfortable Hong Kong win in rain-affected match against Kenya
stories.summary: An aggressive half-century from Babar Hayat set Hong Kong up for a 39-run Duckworth-Lewis win in a rain-affected match against Kenya in Nairobi

image.caption: Babar Hayat sweeps during his quickfire 78
image.longCaption: Babar Hayat sweeps during his quickfire 78, Kenya v Hong Kong, ICC WCL Championship, Nairobi, November 20, 2016
